title: Archaeologist who excavated Amenemhat III's pyramid called it a symbolic tomb for the ka

tellings.quote: the archaeologist, his name starts with a P, that excavated the the pyramid of Aminat III. um he asserted that this was never a tomb and that this was a symbolic tomb for this for the pharaoh's c.

plain: The archaeologist who dug out the pyramid of Amenemhat III, an ancient Egyptian king, is said to have argued that it was never a real tomb. In his view it was only a symbolic tomb for the king's ka, the life force the Egyptians believed every person had. The researcher Luke Caverns tells this, citing an archaeologist of the 1800s whose name, he says, "starts with a P." If true, at least some pyramids were not built as burial places.
